facts.value: Borrows the captive Fighter_GObj. Observed consumers include initial capture through ftCo_800BC7E0 and Koopa ground hit-completion/wait-input repeat paths. Reads x2222_b6 and reciprocal victim_gobj, supplies the linked object as animation source, installs ftCo_800DB464 in accessory1_cb, writes x1A6A=511 through ftCommon_8007E2F4, and invokes ftAnim_8006EBA4. No local null validation or ownership transfer occurs.
facts.rationale: Preserves verified data flow while adding initial-capture provenance and exact common setup effect.

evidence.why: Exact reads, arguments and callback write.

facts.value: Requests ftCo_MS_CaptureDamageKoopa with start=0, requested speed=1, blend argument=0 and victim_gobj as animation source. x2222_b6 selects Ft_MF_FreezeState versus Ft_MF_None. When an animation exists, FreezeState sets x2223_b0, x104=0x14 and effective speed zero. Zero blend requests metadata-default blending, not necessarily no blending. Afterwards installs ftCo_800DB464, sets x1A6A=511 through the common helper and invokes ftAnim_8006EBA4. No local situation, motion or capture-validity guard is present.
facts.rationale: Separates literal arguments from independently verified callee semantics.

facts.value: Requests ftCo_MS_CaptureDamageKoopaAir with start=0, requested speed=1, blend argument=0 and victim_gobj as animation source. x2222_b6 selects Ft_MF_FreezeState versus Ft_MF_None. When an animation exists, FreezeState sets x2223_b0, x104=0x14 and effective speed zero. Zero blend requests metadata-default blending, whose duration is unresolved. Afterwards installs ftCo_800DB464, sets x1A6A=511 through the common helper and invokes ftAnim_8006EBA4. The routine performs no local ground/air or capture-validity check.
facts.rationale: Corrects argument-versus-effective-behavior ambiguity for the air entry.

facts.value: If ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining is false, synchronously invokes ftCo_800BCC20 to enter CaptureWaitKoopa and returns before mash/timer processing, even if the timer was already expired. Otherwise calls ftCo_800BC458, then tests updated grab_timer<=0. True calls ftCo_800DA698 on the linked captor with false, negates captive facing_dir and calls captive CaptureCut. False calls ftCo_800BC4A8; this includes positive timers and unordered NaN under ordinary floating comparison semantics. Both signed zeros release. The false CatchCut argument suppresses its optional nested captive release. Maintenance rate requests may be cached rather than immediately applied while x2223_b0 is set.
facts.rationale: Makes branch priority, floating boundary, release roles and freeze-aware maintenance precise.

facts.value: Uses the shared synchronous helper with ftCo_800BCD00, entering CaptureWaitKoopaAir when ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining is false and returning before timer processing. While frames remain, ftCo_800BC458 runs before updated grab_timer<=0 is tested. True enters CatchCut on the linked captor via ftCo_800DA698(...,false), negates captive facing and enters captive CaptureCut. False invokes ftCo_800BC4A8; it includes NaN as well as positive timers under ordinary floating comparison semantics. Zero releases. The continuation is not retained. Maintenance animation-rate requests are cached while x2223_b0 is set, rather than necessarily changing playback immediately.
facts.rationale: Preserves air-specific continuation while repairing positive-only shorthand and documenting callback lifetime and effective rate behavior.

facts.value: Supplies the registered collision callback for CaptureDamageKoopaAir as a complete no-op. It ignores its Fighter_GObj parameter and performs no local collision test or landing transition. This does not establish that the entire captured fighter or captor requires no collision processing elsewhere.
facts.rationale: Removes unsupported global collision necessity and compiled-opseq implications while preserving proved role.

facts.value: Ground/air entries request animation tuple (0,1,0), conditionally selecting FreezeState from x2222_b6. Effective playback can be frozen and zero blend requests metadata-default blending. Both install the capture-position accessory after state change, write x1A6A=511 and invoke ftAnim_8006EBA4. Completion synchronously enters variant-specific CaptureWaitKoopa before timer processing. Otherwise the updated grab_timer<=0 comparison releases the linked captor into CatchCut, negates captive facing and enters captive CaptureCut; a false comparison, including NaN, runs continued maintenance. Maintenance rate requests can be deferred while frozen. All six IASA/Phys/Coll bodies are empty. The stored accessory is later framework-dispatched and cleared by motion changes; the inline continuation is synchronous and not retained.
facts.rationale: Consolidates verified corrections and the independently observed freeze-aware rate-setter qualification.
